entries.def:
δοκέω, -ῶ
(δόκος, opinion, δέκομαι, Ion, form of δέχ-), [in LXX for טוֹב, נָדַב, etc. ;] 
__1. to be of opinion, suppose: Mat.24.44, Luk.12.40, Heb.10.29; with inf., Mat.3.9, Luk.8.18; 24.37, Jhn.5.39; 16.2, Act.12.9; 27.13, 1Co.3.18; 7.40; 8.2; 10.12; 14.37, Gal.6.3, Php.3.4, Jas.1.26; with accusative and inf., 1Co.12.23, 2Co.11.16; before ὅτι, Mat.6.7; 26.53, Mrk.6.49, Luk.12.51; 13.2, 4; 19.11, Jhn.5.45; 11.13,…

δοκιμάζω
(δόκιμος), [in LXX chiefly for בָּחַן ;] 
__1. primarily of metals (Pro.8.10; 17.3, Sir.2.5, Wis.3.6), to test, try, prove (in the hope and expectation that the test will prove successful, see reff. s. Syn.): χρυσίον, 1Pe.1.7 other things, Luk.12.56; 14.19, 2Co.8.8, Gal.6.4, 1Th.2.4; 5.21; τὰ διαφέροντα, Rom.2.18, Php.1.10 (R, mg., but see infr.); πνεύματα, 1Jn.4.1 of men, 1Ti.3.10 (pass.); ἑαυτόν,…

δοκιμή, -ῆς, ἡ
(δόκιμος), [in Sm.: Psa.68.31 * ;] 
__1. the process of trial, proving, test: 2Co.8.2; 9.13 
__2. The result of trial, approval, approvedness, proof: Rom.5.4, 2Co.2.9; 13.3, Php.2.22 (Cremer, 212, 701).†
(AS)

δοκίμιον, -ου, τό 
[in LXX: Pro.17.3; 27.21 (מִצְרֵף) * ;] 
usually regarded as a variant form of δοκιμεῖον, a test, and so perh. Jas.1.3 (see Mayor, in l), but see next word (cf. Cremer, 212, 702).†
(AS)

δοκίμιος, -α, -ον
(δοκιμή), [in LXX: ἀργύριον δ. (עֲלִיל), Psa.12.6 and as seel. for δόκιμος (B), ἀργυρίου δ. (זָקַק pual.), 1Ch.29.4 (Bab); εἰ δ .ίστιν (יְקָר), Zec.11.13 א with a vid, Q *)* ;] 
= δόκιμος, 
tested, approved: τὸ δ. ὑμῶν τ. πίστεως, that which is approved in your faith, 1Pe.1.7 (where Hort suggests the seel. δόκιμος, found in some cursives), Jas.1.3 (but see Mayor, in l For full discussion of this…

δοκός, -οῦ, ἡ
(δέχομαι) [in LXX for קוֹרָה, etc. ;] 
a beam of timber: Mat.7.3-5, Luk.6.41-42 (DCG, i, 176).†
(AS)

δόλιος, -α, -ον
(δόλος), [in LXX—chiefly in Pss, Pr, Sir—for etc. ;] 
deceitful: 2Co.11.13.†
(AS)

δολιόω
(δόλιος), [in LXX: Num.25.18, Psa.105.25 (נָכַל), Psa.5.6 (חָלַק hi.) * ;] 
to deceive: ἐδολιοῦσαν (-σαν, frequently in κοινή Gk. for imperfect 3rd of person(s) pl.), Rom.3.13 (LXX).†
(AS)

δόλος, -ου, ὁ, 
[in LXX chiefly for מִרְמָה;]
__1. in Hom., a bait. 
__2. a snare. 
__3. In the abstract, craft, deceit: Mat.26.4, Mrk.7.22; 14.1, Jhn.1.47, Act.13.10, Rom.1.29, 2Co.12.16, 1Th.2.3, 1Pe.2.1; 2.22; 3.10" (LXX) (λαλῆσαι δ.).†
(AS)

δολόω, -ῶ
(δόλος) [in LXX: Psa.15.3 (רָגַל), Psa.36.2 (חָלַק hi.) * ;] 
__1. to ensnare. 
__2. As of wine, to adulterate, corrupt: τ. λόγον τ. θεοῦ, 2Co.4.2.†
SYN.: καπηλεύω which see (AS)
